_comment: Copy this file to config.json (it is NOT served to the browser) and add your key. Default provider is Google Gemini's FREE tier — get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (needs a Google login). No pip install is required for Gemini; it uses the Python standard library. Keys may also be supplied via env vars GEMINI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
_anthropic_note: To use Claude instead, set provider to 'anthropic', fill anthropic_api_key, and run: pip install anthropic. Note a Claude Pro/Max subscription does NOT include API access — that is billed separately per token.
